youtube_short.title: Waiting to Invest Is Costing You $163,000
title_alternatives: The 'Perfect Time' to Invest Is Draining Your Retirement
youtube_short.description:
You got a bonus and told yourself you'd invest it 'when things calmed down.' Behavioral economists call this cash drag — and the average delay is 14 months. On $50,000, that's $4,100 in missed growth you'll never get back. Over a 30-year career, five of those delays compound into $163,000 gone. Vanguard's own research shows lump-sum investing beats waiting for a dip 68% of the time. The best day to invest was yesterday. #personalfinance #investing #wealthbuilding

Follow for more money truths every day.

hook_line: 60% of investors are bleeding $163K by 'waiting for the right time'
